title: BEETL Competition 2021 Motor Imagery Dataset A — transfer learning benchmark
description: This dataset provides preprocessed motor imagery EEG recordings from the BEETL Competition 2021 Task 2 (NeurIPS 2021), collected from healthy subjects performing a four-class motor imagery task (rest, left hand, right hand, feet) during an online BCI racing game. The data serve as a benchmark for evaluating transfer learning and domain adaptation methods for subject independence and cross-dataset generalization in brain-computer interfaces. It was converted to BIDS format using the MOABB pipeline and re-hosted on NEMAR.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 500 Hz from 63 channels using a standard 10-05 montage during an online BCI racing game (Cybathlon2020IC) with visual feedback. Each subject completed 5 training races and 10 testing races, with trials lasting 4 seconds each across four motor imagery classes. Online preprocessing applied 1-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filtering, and identical offline filtering was applied before release.
